author: KEXP
description: Seoul -based seven-piece LEENALCHI send listeners down a psychedelic wormhole on their latest EP 'Here Comes That Crow.' In-studio with host Diana Ratsamee, the group deliver an unforgettable performance of "Bird" and more from across their discography.
title: LEENALCHI performs "Birds" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
